chapter_focus: The Wonderful World of Science — branches of science, scientific method, observation and questioning.
intro: These resources extend the chapter for students who want to explore further. Admin should verify each link is current and age-appropriate before approving for the catalog.

items.title: DIKSHA — Class 6 Science Curiosity
items.summary: DIKSHA is the Government of India's national digital learning portal. Search for 'Class 6 Science Curiosity Chapter 1' to find official video and textbook resources matching the new NCERT 2024 syllabus.
items.note_for_teacher: Admin: confirm chapter-1-specific content is available; the portal is updated with each curriculum revision.

items.title: NCERT CIET — Educational Videos
items.summary: The NCERT Central Institute of Educational Technology hosts videos and animations for school subjects. Useful for teachers preparing demos around the scientific method.
items.note_for_teacher: Admin: verify Class 6 'How Science Works' video is publicly listed before approving.

items.title: Khan Academy India — Science Foundations
items.summary: Short, plain-language videos that introduce 'what science is' and the steps of the scientific method, suitable as homework reinforcement.
items.note_for_teacher: Admin: pick a specific video and replace this generic URL with the deep link before approving.

items.title: Curious Kids — Why questions answered by scientists
items.summary: A series where real scientists answer 'why' questions sent in by school children. Great example of curiosity-driven science.
items.note_for_teacher: Admin: check that the article picked is age-appropriate.

items.title: PhET Interactive Simulations
items.summary: Free educational simulations from the University of Colorado. Browse the 'Physics' and 'Biology' sections for hands-on simulations linked to chapter concepts.
items.note_for_teacher: Admin: PhET is reliable but most simulations are for higher classes; pick simpler ones for Class 6.
